text: Have it as you please.” “I don’t know, however,” said Caspar Goodwood, “that my keeping you in sight would prevent it.” “Don’t you indeed? I’m after all very much afraid of you. Do you think I’m so very easily pleased?” she asked suddenly, changing her tone. “No--I don’t; I shall try to console myself with that. But there are a certain number of very dazzling men in the world, no doubt; and if there were only one it would be enough.
